headline: Electrician
summary: TESDA-certified electrician with a year of residential and condominium work in Pasig. I install wiring, outlets, lighting, panels and household appliances to the Philippine Electrical Code, and I read electrical plans before starting any job. I take safety on site seriously.

projects.name: Condominium unit rewiring
bullets: Rewired 12 condo units, installing new panels, circuits, outlets and LED lighting.
Every unit passed the building administrator's inspection on the first visit.

projects.name: Aircon and water heater installations
projects.description: Installed dedicated circuits and mounted about 40 split-type aircons and water heaters for households.

skills: Electrical installation: wiring, panels, outlets, lighting
Talking clearly with clients about the work

experience.title: Electrician
bullets: Install wiring, panels and lighting in condominium units and houses with a team of four.
Mount and connect aircons, water heaters and range hoods on dedicated circuits.
Follow the electrical plans and check each circuit with a tester before energising.
Wear harness and PPE on ladders and scaffolds and keep work areas tidy.

experience.title: Electrician Trainee
bullets: Pulled wires, installed boxes and assisted the lead electrician on house projects.

education.credential: Electrical Installation and Maintenance NC II

certifications.name: Electrical Installation and Maintenance NC II
